environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with default container configuration. Container runs as non-root user (uid 1000) but filesystem is writable. /tmp is available as standard container tmpfs. No WAF or API gateway in front of the service. Service exposed directly via NLB on port 8080. Spring Security configured but /api/v1/config/reload endpoint lacks authentication (missing @PreAuthorize annotation).
